fixer.title: Default new cloud automations to no allowed tools

introducer.title: sessions: add cloud automations to the composer dialog

cases.mechanism: A cold remote tool-catalog lookup was made a prerequisite of saving every new cloud automation that retained the default selection, keeping the save transaction and UI blocked for the full network duration even though the new default can be represented without the catalog.
cases.symptom: Creating a cloud automation immediately after opening the dialog left the save UI busy and delayed the subsequent create request until `/automations/tools` completed; catalog failure also prevented progress.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed save path reads the already-initialized `selectedTools` value directly. New cloud automations initialize it to an explicit empty array, so saving no longer awaits the remote tool catalog; the existing dialog autorun may still load the catalog asynchronously for the picker, off the save critical path.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, `getSessionConfiguration` called `resolveSelectedTools`, whose line 1946 awaited `waitForState(configuration.tools, catalog => catalog.kind !== 'loading', ...)`. This method runs inside `AutomationDialogService.save()` before `options.commit`, while the form is inert and the save button is disabled. The production provider implements `loadTools()` as an authenticated `GET /automations/tools`; it caches/coalesces loading and ready states, but a cold request still determines save latency. The replaced regression test explicitly showed that an early save remained pending until the catalog observable was set to ready.
